# uzc_vpn_user (Resource)

Manages a UzCloud VPN user. There is no update endpoint, so changing any attribute recreates the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_vpn_user" "example" {
  username       = "example-vpn-user"
  password       = var.vpn_user_password
  cloud_provider = "nimbo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider slug.
- `password` (String, Sensitive)
- `username` (String)

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project slug. Falls back to the provider's `project` default when unset.
- `region` (String) Region slug. Falls back to the provider's `region` default when unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`. Used as the Terraform resource ID.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug, used for import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_vpn_user.example <vpn-user-slug>
```
